cause: The v1 contract incorrectly encoded the historical selector ceiling of 40 as an exact per-row count of 40. The immutable first report contains 3 to 40 candidates per row, average 29.94; 56 of 100 rows contain exactly 40.
repairPolicy: Preserve the v1 contract and freeze. Create a v1.1 amendment and a new run id. Do not change candidate identities, cost definitions, optimization thresholds or stop rules.
